digest.component_or_area: git hooks installation and pre-commit integration
propositions: The documented curl command for installing commit-msg hook uses git rev-parse --git-path, which resolves to the shared hooks directory when run from a linked worktree, causing the pre-commit wrapper to be clobbered across all worktrees on the host.

Pre-commit migration mode chains both the Gerrit Change-Id stamper and the 50/72 message gate; the documented curl overwrite breaks this chain and makes Change-Id stamping invisible until a Gerrit push is rejected.
The unsafe behavior is silent at commit time and only surfaces at git push gerrit, potentially in a different worktree than the one that ran the install command.
The fix consolidates hook installation into make hooks with a new install-gerrit-hook.sh script that is worktree-safe, non-destructive, idempotent, and refuses to overwrite non-wrapper hooks.
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must be updated to remove the bare curl command and direct users to the single idempotent path via make hooks.
